questions.stem: A notice states a shop closes at six. Which inference is not licensed?

The shop is closed after six.
The shop opens at six.
The shop exists.

questions.explanation: Closing at six does not imply opening at six. A, C and D are either restatements or valid inferences.
questions.hint: Closing time is not opening time.
